sets.title: PrimeSync · frozen account comparison
sets.sizing: Candidate: one micro per frozen eligible entry. Baseline: archived funded/evaluation stacks and published 19-piece personal reference (Claude 6416de2).
sets.costs: Evaluation/funded: $1.04 per micro round trip plus one adverse tick on market/stop/time fills. Personal candidate: $1.275 per unit round trip; inherited portfolio accounting applies.
sets.method: Funded: 1,000 paired two-year histories, 20-day blocks. Personal: 1,000 paired 252-day histories. Evaluation: 2,174 complete 21-day starts, including 885 since 2023.
sets.outcome: No tested placement clears its preregistered materiality gates. Closest personal ES30 addition improves mean-profit/p95-drawdown by 1.8%, below the 5% requirement.
sets.verification: Native MultiCharts parity and independent signal validation outstanding. These are saved historical results, not a rerun against today's portfolio.
sets.limits: Conditional on sampled history. Funded paths retain CL/OT daily-adverse and MOC close-path approximations; personal bookkeeping retains mixed marking/fee approximations. Two-year funded payout is cumulative, not year-two income.
sets.comparison_note: REPLACE substitutes PrimeSync for Vault Break; EMPTY removes Vault Break without a substitute.
